outcome.answer: Yes. The supplied papers propose multiple machine learning approaches for detecting early cognitive decline and early-stage Alzheimer’s/mild cognitive impairment (MCI), using clinical/neuropsychological data and neuroimaging (among others) [1], multimodal contactless behavioral signals from structured voice interactions (video/audio/text) [2], multimodal temporal behavioral decay modeling for MCI over multiple sessions [3], multilingual speech-based detection with cross-linguistic transfer learning [4], and statistical/machine learning models using linguistic features from speech transcripts [6].
